alternative.serverless: a hosted inference API instead of self-hosting models

rules.why: The codebase loads local model libraries ({evidence_names}), which need GPU-capable machines such as {service} for acceptable speed.
The codebase serves streaming or WebSocket traffic ({evidence_names}). Plain functions have request time limits, so {service} is used to hold the connections.

caveats.text: Streaming or WebSocket responses run into function time limits; confirm the limits in the vendor documentation before relying on this design.
WebSocket connections need a service that holds connections; plain functions cannot.
Raise the load balancer idle timeout and disable response buffering on the streaming route (SEC-004).
Raise the load balancer idle timeout so long-lived WebSocket connections are not dropped (SEC-004).
The code uses a local SQLite file. It cannot be shared by several instances and is lost on managed compute without a mounted volume (SEC-003); migrate the data to the managed database.
Queue consumers on functions have execution time limits; long jobs may need an always-on worker.
